name: Bridging stay permit

permit_transition.text_en: Which transition between stay permits do you need?

labels_en.evisa_visit_to_itas: From a visit stay permit applied for through evisa.imigrasi.go.id to a limited stay permit (ITAS).
labels_en.nonextendable_itas_to_new_permit: From a limited stay permit (ITAS) that can no longer be extended to a new stay permit.
labels_en.nonextendable_itap_to_new_permit: From a permanent stay permit (ITAP) that can no longer be extended to a new stay permit.

onshore.text_en: Are you already in Indonesia, and will you remain in Indonesia while using this bridging stay permit?

application_deadline.text_en: Can you apply through evisa.imigrasi.go.id and pay the immigration fee no later than 3 days before your current stay permit expires?

notes: The three transition options retain the qualifications in allowed_activities verbatim. The visit permit must have been applied for through evisa; ITAS/ITAP must no longer be extendable. The source says new stay permit for ITAS/ITAP holders, without specifying its class; the following sentence discusses conversion to ITAS. That scope remains TO_VERIFY. No ITAP destination or conversion entitlement is inferred.
Three questions per path. A no to onshore or the application/payment deadline gives NOT_COVERED. An absent or unlisted transition is asked again; no other permit transition is inferred.

A matching path gives TO_VERIFY, not OK: the nationwide sponsor Boolean is unstated. The Jakarta Pusat sponsor account and checklist are office-specific, and no sponsor exemption or national sponsor requirement is inferred.
The published validity is exactly 60 DAY. It is not converted into months or years, and no duration question is invented. Leaving Indonesia ends this permit's validity.

OWNER RULING 2026-10-19: BRIDGING is not extendable (extendable false). Basis, Permenkumham 11/2024 Pasal 86A ayat (1): 'Izin Tinggal Kunjungan bagi Orang Asing dalam rangka peralihan Izin Tinggal Keimigrasian sebagaimana dimaksud dalam Pasal 80 ayat (3) huruf f dan ayat (4) huruf d diberikan untuk jangka waktu paling lama 60 (enam puluh) hari dan tidak dapat diperpanjang.' The quote is in the card's regulation_verbatim, separate from the page extraction (whose extendable field stays null).

All nine requirements remain a verbatim checklist, never document-possession questions. Application and payment no later than 3 days before expiry is a legal timing condition, not a request to upload documents.
The central press URL returned 404; the substantive official Depok republication is the main source. Source-document hashes and the Jakarta Pusat local scope remain in the card.
Only single_entry_visas / Bridging Visa is an exact commercial key. Its catalog category does not grant single entry: entry_type remains null. Stamp duties are not PNBP or client prices.

Cumulative maximum, entry entitlement, nationwide sponsor rule, PNBP amount and the checklist's applicability outside Jakarta Pusat remain TO_VERIFY. No ITAP.json was supplied for this non-E family; DB itap stays null.
